description: Launch thread for the 2026-07-07 ten-feature drop. Tweet 1 leads with the map (the most screenshot-shaped asset · attach a /map screenshot before posting). tweets:
The bitcoin circular economy, mapped.

New on Galaxy Mind: galaxymind.space/map

galaxymind.space/today

We built a time machine so you can check. Pick an amount and a date: spending WITHOUT replacing is the only losing branch. Replace same day and your stack never notices.

galaxymind.space/spend-and-replace

Did the wrapper beat the coin? The chart answers daily.

galaxymind.space/treasuries

And for your own site: the Supply Clock is now embeddable. Two lines of HTML puts the falling bitcoin float on any page, ticking live.

Every embed grows the signal.

galaxymind.space/embed

Power user notes: press Cmd+K anywhere on the site to jump to any merchant, tool, or definition. And scroll the 21M grid on galaxymind.space/float · the supply story now tells itself.

All free, no ads, no listing fees. Built for bitcoiners who spend.
